product_metadata.title: DampRid Fragrance Free Refillable Moisture Absorber - 10.5oz cup – Traps Moisture for Fresher, Cleaner Air
features: DampRid Refillable Moisture Absorbers are convenient 10.5-ounce cups that attract and trap excess moisture out of the air
DampRid eliminates odors by absorbing excess airborne moisture that creates unpleasant, musty smells.
Great for use in a bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, closet, home gym, and any space where excess moisture is an issue.
The 10.5-ounce cup lasts up to 60 days, depending on temperature and humidity.
To use, remove lid and pour crystals from bag into the top tray of the canister. Once odor absorbing crystals have dissolved, discard water from canister and refill for longer lasting freshness
description: DampRid Refillable Moisture Absorber Cups are your solution for continuous cleaner, fresher air. This musty odor eliminator works by attracting and trapping excess moisture to maintain an optimal humidity level. Works wonders as a closet deodorizer, freshener, or odor neutralizer wherever moisture in an issue. Spread these non-electric dehumidifiers out between the bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, nursery, or home office. To use this convenient odor absorber, simply open the bag of crystals, pour into the top tray of the canister and close lid. When the odor absorbing crystals have dissolved, dispose of the water by pouring into a toilet, then refill with new crystals. These air deodorizer odor eliminator cups are available in Fragrance Free, Fresh Scent, Lavender Vanilla, and Pure Linen. Keep out of reach of children. Read and follow all label directions.
